“As we demonstrated in the third quarter, we remain focused on executing key clinical and regulatory milestones, expanding our commercial opportunities, and maintaining a disciplined approach as we advance toward the anticipated OCU400 Phase 3 topline data early next year.” Ocugen continues to advance its three late-stage modifier gene therapy programs toward key clinical and regulatory milestones, with OCU400 expected to be the first Phase 3 study to read out in the first quarter of 2027.

It is Ocugen’s second regional OCU400 license agreement, following Kwangdong Pharmaceutical in South Korea · Top-line data from the 140-patient Phase 3 liMeliGhT trial are expected in the first quarter of 2027, followed by a planned Biologics License Application (BLA) submission; completed Process Performance Qualification (PPQ) batches to support the BLA and commercial launch supply OCU410ST (Stargardt disease) · Topline data from the Phase 2/3 pivotal confirmatory trial (N=63 subjects) are anticipated in the second quarter of 2027, with a planned BLA submission to follow OCU410 (GA) · Announced the first patient dosed in ArMaDa3, a 240-subject global Phase 3 trial randomizing patients 2:1 to a single subretinal injection of OCU410 or untreated control across the U.S., Canada, and Europe; the primary endpoint is GA lesion growth over 12 months · Presented 12-month Phase 2 ArMaDa2 results at three scientific conferences, including two podium presentations at AAO 2026 Corporate Updates • Named Jolanda Crombach General Manager of its newly established European affiliate in Amsterdam to support the OCU410 Phase 3 development program, upcoming marketing authorization submissions, and potential commercialization in Europe.
